assertions.requirement: A closed kind/target selects the fixed registered capability and profile; specs cannot inject lifecycle callbacks, placement or evidence.
assertions.candidateEvidence: contracts/job-policy.ts and targets/job-profiles.ts; closed-spec ESLint and ordinary Vitest discovery controls.

assertions.requirement: Cleanup intent and a fresh complete inventory fence precede each send. Original controller, credential, explicit and resolved placement, provisional transitions and every validated attempt prefix survive missing replies or later failures.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/job-attempt-ledger.ts; test/integration/e2e/internal/job-native-cleanup.ts; test/integration/e2e/internal/transports/public-cloud-job.ts: JobAttemptLedger, JobNativeCleanup, public-cloud-job adapter and original-controller Workload mutation hook; strict inventory/provisional/lost-reply regressions.

assertions.requirement: Persisted terminal cleanup, complete attempt history and independent native absence are required before release; cleanup uses its original identity, independent cancellation scope and remaining deadline.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/job-native-cleanup.ts; test/integration/e2e/internal/contracts/dedicated-job.ts: #finalize; JobNativeCleanup and independent native readers; cancellation, partial-history and failed automatic-cleanup regressions.

assertions.requirement: Only the family finalizer consumes exact run/reference/generation-bound active and required extension evidence once, then releases children and shared resources before its sole completion result. Terminal-only, copied, mismatched, missing, early or reused records reject.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/contracts/job-records.ts: begin/progress/extension/terminal/claim; test/integration/e2e/internal/contracts/dedicated-job.ts: #finalize; evidence ownership and finalizer controls.

assertions.requirement: The named forced failure produces no completion. Preserve primary and cleanup failures and inspect raw native/resource registrations before rescue. Compact records retain source/profile/run/attempt/generation and durations for at least 30 days.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/contracts/dedicated-job.ts: E2E_JOB_FORCE_CLEANUP; fixture-record/cleanup-observations/native records; existing e2e-job comparison artifact uploads and retention policy.

assertions.requirement: Register imported API credential intent before mutation, bind its original controller and provider identity, sanitize actual child environments and suppress secret-producing output before recording artifacts. Complete API absence readback precedes credential release.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/transports/public-cloud-job.ts: JobAuthorization bootstrap owner and JobPrivateCommands; isolatedJobEnvironment, JobCloudSession and ApiClient readback; original-controller, deadline, schema and redaction controls.

assertions.requirement: Bind the requested profile and observed image configuration/API manifest to the original active attempt and exact resolved placement. An omitted zone is accepted only for an originally null zone; explicit or known placement mismatches reject.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/job-attempt-ledger.ts; test/integration/e2e/internal/contracts/dedicated-job.ts: #cloudProgress active baseline; imageConfigDigest and original VmLedgerProbe/JobAttemptLedger observations.

assertions.requirement: A non-completed Spot Job reaches Running within 1200 seconds; its exact original instance has one persistent request active within 60 seconds in the original account/region.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/transports/job-spot.ts; test/integration/e2e/internal/contracts/dedicated-job.ts; test/integration/e2e/internal/contracts/job-records.ts; test/integration/e2e/internal/transports/public-cloud-job.ts: #spotMember; JobSpotTransport.active/request exact provider request, Workload tags, VM and credential identity.

assertions.requirement: After public Workload termination, observe persisted cleanup within 600 seconds and the same persistent request cancelled within 120 seconds.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/transports/job-spot.ts; test/integration/e2e/internal/contracts/dedicated-job.ts; test/integration/e2e/internal/contracts/job-records.ts; test/integration/e2e/internal/transports/public-cloud-job.ts: #spotMember sameRequest guard and independent JobSpotTransport request observation; original automatic failure is retained.

assertions.requirement: For a full 90 seconds, inventory both original Workload tags and original request ID and find no live original or replacement instance; final exact request remains cancelled.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/transports/job-spot.ts; test/integration/e2e/internal/contracts/dedicated-job.ts; test/integration/e2e/internal/contracts/job-records.ts; test/integration/e2e/internal/transports/public-cloud-job.ts: #spotMember existing provider clock/pause capability; JobSpotTransport.liveInstances strict complete inventories and deadline; final request read.

assertions.requirement: Cleanup records request intent before mutation, cancels every owned persistent request before terminating native instances, and retains known identities after partial inventory or lost replies.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/transports/job-spot.ts; test/integration/e2e/internal/contracts/dedicated-job.ts; test/integration/e2e/internal/contracts/job-records.ts; test/integration/e2e/internal/transports/public-cloud-job.ts: JobSpotTransport independent cleanup scope/deadline and reservation history; original request/VM/account/region guards and partial/lost-reply regressions.

assertions.requirement: The named forced failure follows the active request baseline. Rescue cancellation/native deletion cannot turn a failed automatic-cancellation or no-replacement assertion into success.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/contracts/dedicated-job.ts; test/integration/e2e/internal/contracts/job-records.ts; test/integration/e2e/internal/transports/public-cloud-job.ts: #spotMember forced boundary and finalizer; primary/secondary error preservation; cleanup registration remains armed until exact readback.

assertions.requirement: A second Spot Job is terminated as soon as its attempt names a launched instance. The request the instance names, read by request ID and bound to that instance, must reach cancelled, and a full 90-second guard must find no live original or replacement instance. With that fix reverted, the run fails when the old instance-id lookup misses the request (an earlier race), because the request is never cancelled; it passes when that lookup already finds the request, because the old code then cancels it. The instance-id lookup before, at and after the cancel, launch time and cancel time are recorded as evidence and gate nothing.
assertions.candidateEvidence: test/integration/e2e/internal/contracts/dedicated-job.ts: #spotEarlyCancel, #spotCancelled; test/integration/e2e/internal/transports/job-spot.ts launched/instanceFilter; test/unit/e2e-cloud-job-contract.spec.ts early-reopened, recorded-not-gated cases, late-instance; test/unit/e2e-job-spot.spec.ts.
